intro: Crown of the Earth is a quest in Darnassus that begins when Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm abandons a failed incantation involving a phial of water. Dismissed by the frustrated Arch Druid, the adventurer is tasked with delivering the drained vessel to Priestess Lariia at the Temple of the Moon for disposal. However, upon examining the phial, the priestess notices that some water remains inside, casting doubt on why the ritual truly failed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take the phial and get out of my sight, druid. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before.
Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.
I must look elsewhere if this is to work...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do not mind the Arch Druid, friend. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.
Wait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?
